crowd_oooh: Small group of friends in a living room going ooooh together in playful suspicion, close and short
crowd_laugh: Small group of friends bursting into loud laughter in a living room, close-mic
crowd_cheer: Small group of friends cheering yeah and clapping briefly in a living room
stamp: Rubber stamp slammed hard onto paper on a wooden table, one heavy thump
gulp: Single nervous cartoon gulp, one loud swallow
drip: Single water droplet falling into water, tiny high plip
riser: Fast airy whoosh rising upward, short and smooth
swish: Soft quick swish of a playing card sliding through the air
pop: Soft round cartoon bubble pop, short
thud: Soft cartoon thud of a small toy landing on a cushion
deal: Playing card dealt onto a felt table, single crisp flick
boom: Big comedic impact boom, deep cartoon hit with a short tail
confetti: Party popper burst with paper confetti falling
roulette: Single short click of a spinning prize wheel peg, wooden
